title: The existing rational PBC purity scalar-comparison models
statement: Let l be prime, E and F finite extensions of Q_l, and f:X→Y a quasi-compact morphism of Noetherian schemes of finite dimension on which l is invertible. With the completed coefficient operations of [def-pur-rational-purity-coefficient-models], define the actual rational twisted inverse image H_E=Lf^*(-)(d)[2d], compactification image P_E=Rp_*j_!, and their specified scalar comparisons. Their components are the rationalizations of the shift/Tate/pullback tensor comparisons and the proper/open coefficient mate, respectively. Normalize the raw scalar transitions by the inverse of [def-zl-pbc-finite-raw-scalar-comparison]; conjugation defines StageA and StageC on the pbcScalarSystem of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. This is a verbatim relocation of the existing proved scalar API, with no changed notion, theorem, or comparison map.

proof.text: Retain the existing actual twisted and compact ambient functors, their lattice preservation and scalar linearity; rationalize by the published conditional scalar localization.

The completed coefficient square is equality after all finite projections. Restrict the integral comparison natural transformations and extend naturality through scalar denominators. Use the existing integral compact scalar invertibility bridge. These are the original completed Lean proofs, moved verbatim.

The inverse of the unique finite/raw comparison gives the unique normalization; every rational object is an integral representative. Conjugate the two raw scalar comparisons by this normalization to define StageA and StageC.
